highlights: Constructed database schema by designing conceptual ERD to guide seamless backend integration.
Modernized legacy database infrastructure using SQLAlchemy 2.0+ and native Python type hints to reduce foreseen runtime errors and improve team performance.
Managed database migrations and version control via Alembic to maintain schema integrity, prevent data loss, and ensure continuous deployment readiness.
Improved onboarding efficiency by authoring comprehensive documentation and access workarounds for development tools for future team members.
Collaborated within an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in daily stand-ups and sprint planning.
Prototyped a compact tactical underground sensor system for military drone deployment.
Integrated microcontroller with multiple sensors (vibration, motion, etc.) to develop a functional tennis-ball-sized sensing device.
Programmed sensor threshold logic through an IDE to filter false positives and trigger alerts only during significant motion or tampering events.
Developed real-time GUI for live sensor activity and system alerts for monitoring and testing.

volunteer.summary: Collaborated with team to maintain a previously developed Grafana dashboard reading weather data from two deployed weather boxes on campus.
highlights: Researched multiple dashboard programs that would be cost effective and satisfy team's needs.
Presented monthly updates to the team and advisor to showcase dashboard status.
